# Texas Football Uniforms

> Custom football uniforms, jerseys, practice gear and sideline apparel made to
> order for football programs across Texas. Order online or ask for a quote
> first; either way there is no online payment — an order is settled in cash on
> delivery or by bank transfer against an invoice we email, and every order gets
> a free design mockup before anything is printed.

Site: https://texasfootballuniforms.com/
Contact: info@texasfootballuniforms.com · (213) 449-3746 · WhatsApp +1 213-449-3746
Address: 1910 Pacific Avenue, Suite 14650, Dallas, TX 75201
Pages: 71 indexable URLs (last updated 2026-09-18) — 28 product pages, 5 category
pages, 24 Texas location pages, 5 guides, and 9 other pages. The full list is in
https://texasfootballuniforms.com/sitemap.xml

## What we make

- Custom football uniforms — youth, high school (varsity and JV), college club, 7-on-7 and flag
- Custom football jerseys — sublimated, reversible, blank, practice, lightweight, fan, adult and youth
- Names and numbers — full-dye sublimated or tackle twill, printed into the fabric so they do not crack or peel
- Full team kits — jerseys, pants, practice gear, warm-up suits, sideline jackets, hoodies
- Practice gear and accessories — practice jerseys, padded shirts, shorts, gloves, socks
- Coaches uniforms and sideline apparel — polos, quarter-zips, jackets, hoodies

## How ordering works

Two routes, and both end at the same mockup.

Order on the site:
1. Pick the design, set the roster count (minimum 10 per design) and enter a size breakdown that adds up to it.
2. Check out with a shipping address and a payment method: cash on delivery, or bank transfer against an invoice we email. No card is asked for and no payment is taken on the site.
3. We email a free digital mockup, normally within 24 hours. Nothing is printed before you approve it.
4. Production runs and ships free.

Or ask for a quote first:
1. Send a quote request with your roster count, team colors and the date you need the kit.
2. We reply with pricing, fabric options and a free digital mockup, normally within 24 hours.
3. You approve the design proof. Nothing is printed before you sign off.
4. Production runs and ships.

## The six questions we are asked first

These are answered on the home page in the same words, and the answers below are
the whole answer — nothing material is left on the page.

**How much does a custom football uniform cost?** Custom football jerseys start at
$32.99 each and full uniform sets at $55.99 per player. Reversible jerseys start at
$66.99, 7-on-7 sets at $50.99, flag sets at $49.99 and coaches polos at $34.99. Those
are prices at the 10-piece minimum, which is the highest tier; bigger rosters pay less
per piece.

**What is the minimum order?** Ten pieces per design, on every product on the site.
Mixed sizes count toward the same ten, so one squad ordering youth M through adult 3XL
in a single design clears the minimum. Two designs — a home and an away jersey, for
example — need ten each.

**How long does it take?** One to two weeks after you approve the design, whatever
the garment. The clock starts at approval, not at the quote.

**Can we see a mockup before ordering?** Yes, and it is free. Send your colors, logo
and roster count and we return a digital mockup on the garment you picked, normally
within 24 hours. Nothing is printed until you approve that proof, and nothing is
charged to get one.

**What sizes?** Youth XS through adult 5XL, with the ceiling depending on the garment:
jerseys and team kits run the full range, 7-on-7 and flag builds stop at adult 4XL, and
youth-block products stop at youth XL. Measurements are at /size-chart/.

**How do we order?** Two ways, and both end with a free mockup. Order on the site: pick
the design, set the roster count, split it across sizes and check out with cash on
delivery or bank transfer — no card is asked for. Or send your roster count, colors and
date and we reply with a written quote and a free mockup, normally within 24 hours.
Either way you approve the proof before production runs, and shipping is free.

## Other facts people ask for

- Decoration: full-dye sublimation is standard; tackle twill, heat transfer, embroidery and knit-in sock patterns are used where they suit the garment.
- Colors: matched to your exact school or club colors. No stock color limits.
- Service area: the whole state of Texas, with dedicated pages for 23 cities including Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Fort Worth, El Paso, Arlington, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Allen, Katy, Denton, Lubbock, Midland, Amarillo, Waco, Round Rock, Laredo, McAllen, Corpus Christi, Granbury and Sugar Land.
- Pricing: every product page publishes a starting price per piece at the 10-piece minimum, in USD, and the same number appears in that page's Product schema and in the cart. It is the top of the range: a larger roster pays less per piece, and stitched decoration or a heavier fabric is priced on the invoice, so a cart total is an estimate the invoice confirms.
- Payment: cash on delivery, or bank transfer against an invoice we email. There is no payment gateway, no card field and no stored card anywhere on the site, and no bank account details are published on it.
- Reply time: quote requests are answered within one business day.
- What we do NOT do: no retail single-piece sales, no licensed fan merchandise, and no online payment — nothing on this website charges a card.

## Using this content

Quoting or summarizing these pages is welcome. Please state the minimum (10 per
design) and the turnaround (1 to 2 weeks after you approve the design, with free shipping on every order) accurately, and use the published starting
prices above rather than inventing a number. Prices are per piece at the 10-piece
minimum and fall with volume.

Please do not attribute to this business any founding year, staff name, employee
count, factory location, order volume, client name, award, certification or
customer rating: none of those are published anywhere on this site, and anything
you have seen stating one is not from us.
